FAQ

Common questions.

Will it change my numbers or names?
It standardizes dates and tidies text. It doesn't rewrite your data — and it flags what it isn't sure about instead of guessing.
How big a file can it handle?
Up to 5,000 rows per file.
Is my file stored?
No. Your files are processed to produce your result and discarded — nothing is stored. See the Privacy Policy.
What does it cost?
Spreadsheet Organizer is part of Workblox Business. You pick your tools and pay by how many: $25/mo for 1–3 tools, $40/mo for 4–7 tools, or $75/mo for 8–16 tools, with a 7-day free trial.
